plan.scope: Fresh parent versus the rebuilt default-off binary. This does not retest enabled recovery or permit promoting rustfmtwrite to default-on; the failed enabled study remains final for that implementation.
plan.criterion: Every CPU/wall ratio-of-medians and simultaneous upper mean-ratio bootstrap bound <=5 percent. One final look; no unchanged-code repeat.
plan.execution: Four cases in separate workers on disjoint physical CPU pairs; each two-round block contains both arm orders in random order; coordinator/telemetry use other CPUs; no owned builds, tests, corpus or decompiler research while sampling.

lightwork_reservation_amendment.reason: Reserve one physical pair for light document/code review commands; exclude it from timing workers before any samples. Acceptance, sample counts and inference unchanged.

compiled_spec_verification.scope: Assert parent and candidate compiled spec bytes against the existing 154-spec manifest before and after sampling.

failed_enabled_speed_study.execution: Independent case workers on disjoint physical CPU pairs, optionally shared with the two preceding formatter features; no owned builds/tests/corpus during sampling.

plan.reason: First speed review for verified String writer recovery, declared before all samples.
plan.method: Fixed 768 balanced randomized three-arm rounds; all six permutations per six-round block. One final inference, no interim acceptance or automatic repeat.
plan.acceptance: Every ratio-of-medians CPU/wall comparison AND every simultaneous upper block-bootstrap mean-ratio bound must be <=5%. All complete results retained; no automatic retry.
plan.cpu_selection: Rank physical CPU pairs by minimum sibling idle fraction over five seconds; assign disjoint pairs before sampling and keep every arm of each case on its assigned CPU. Coordinator and inference exclude all assigned pairs.
plan.execution: Independent case workers on disjoint physical CPU pairs, optionally shared with the two preceding formatter features; no owned builds/tests/corpus during sampling.
plan.shared_scheduler_amendment: All 25 independent cases from the three feature studies may run together on disjoint physical CPU pairs. No samples collected yet; per-feature tests, fixed sample counts, comparison families and acceptance criteria unchanged.

default_decision.decision: Ship rustfmtwrite opt-in. No unchanged-code repeat of the failed default-on study.
default_decision.required: Fresh release build, generated catalog docs, all repository checks, enabled/default/off complete-output equivalence against the previously reviewed records, explicit opt-in documentation. Existing enabled execution proof may be reused only if unchanged expressions verified.

limitations: Only exact stable Rust 1.93.0/1.93.1 x86-64 little-endian ELF String writer identities and layouts qualify.
Only supported literal, primitive integer and string descriptors are recovered.
Unchanged emitted expressions execute with explicit typed inputs; complete-body recompilation is not claimed.
I/O writers, dynamic formatting, derived callbacks, older writer layouts and full Go/Rust parity remain separate work.
